name: 柔光干粉 · Pastel Dry Powder

source_summary.provenance: Observed from eleven supplied product storyboard stills and their authored production notes; private images and client documents are not redistributed.

visual_rules.medium_behavior: 摄影级产品CG，柔光棚拍的包材塑形与选择性干粉微距；真实材质响应服务于可控的艺术化运动。
palette_logic: 目标产品颜色优先；未锁色时以浅紫空间、冷白底面和低饱和浅粉作柔和层次，黑色包材承担轮廓对比。
不同粉色只出现在目标声明的材料区域，色彩边界在近焦面仍可区分。
visual_rules.shape_line_language: 主体几何与目标产品一致；阵列靠重复、错位和透视建立节奏，英雄主体保持清晰轮廓。
texture_material_logic: 包材以宽柔反射带、清楚倒角与受控轮廓高光呈现；哑面、镜面和粉体有不同响应。
干压粉芯边缘完整。松散粉体的主体是极细干燥颜料尘，绝大多数单粒在当前距离不可独立分辨；清晰粒子的最大直径以承载盘可见宽度的1/150为视觉设计上限，密根部逐渐过渡到薄而透光的稀疏前缘。
接触材质按目标工具区分绒面、刷毛或硬探头；接触形变、粘附和离面颗粒分别可读。
visual_rules.lighting_logic: 大面积侧前柔光塑形，受控边缘光分离深色壳体；微距用掠射光读粉面，背景保持低频连续渐变。
composition_logic: 一个明确主产品，前景掠过元素和后景阵列只提供层次。
微距将焦点落在材料交界或接触边缘；回到英雄画面时保留产品整体识别。
visual_rules.optics_rendering_logic: 按镜头目的选择产品近景与窄焦面微距；细节分布随焦面变化，运动模糊只属于有运动的层。
motifs: 接触与离面之间的可见状态差

inferred_traits: 让细、轻、可接触的干粉材料被看见，而非只展示包装。
These rules are a transferable design interpretation, not the source creators’ complete production method.
unknowns: Exact source lens, shader parameters, simulation settings and full frame-by-frame motion are not established by these rules.
Image transfer does not establish temporal stability or final video quality.
transfer_rules: Target identity, material, geometry, function, palette, layout, text and requested medium remain authoritative.
Select compatible visual mechanisms; do not import every motif into every target.
forbidden_transfer: Source product identity, exact packaging, protected marks, source wording and layout coordinates.
粉体不能借用碎石、糖粒、结块、湿液体或棉花烟团的外观；相对颗粒尺度只是视觉设计意图，不是产品实测粒径或功效声明。

prompts: 制作一个原创、无品牌的产品CG纯画面。斜俯视产品近景，盖缘、铰链与干粉表面清楚，一小束双色极细干粉在盘缘起始展开；粉芯完整。 一个无品牌六角形深石墨色铝制压粉盒，盖子以真实后铰链打开，内部只有一块米白与浅杏双色干压粉芯。
制作一个原创、无品牌的产品CG纯画面。真实细粒颜料的接触微距，短绒接触面带少量粉末，与粉面之间有清楚间隙和极细离面颗粒；焦点在绒面与粉面交界，两个颜色不混成一种。 两个无品牌浅圆陶瓷碟并排盛放极细磨制靛蓝与赭红艺术颜料，一枚扁平椭圆短绒涂抹头刚离开右碟表面。绒面为细密极短的天鹅绒，仅一毫米级短绒观感，不是长刷毛。
validation.notes: Two different target scenarios were generated without source-image attachments and independently inspected. Static style transfer passed with recorded limitations. Actual PNGs are 1672x941; exact canvas, some framing/material-scale facts and moving-video behavior are not fully verified. This is not user adoption. See the validation record and separate evidence asset. Initial coarse-grain/long-brush attempts are retained as failures; the two revised attempts were evaluated. Lid cropping remains a known output defect. Prompt entries are the target briefs; exact compiled native prompts and their SHA-256 are retained in the separate evidence asset.

evidence.review: Soft graphite reflections, two-color pressed core and a finer dense-to-sparse dry plume transferred. Coarse chunks were reduced after the first attempt. The upper lid remains cropped; part of the powder edge is occluded. Particle-size ratio is not measured.

Two pigment colors remain separate. The revised oval short-velvet applicator replaces the initial long bristles; adhered powder and lifted fine dust are visible. Granule aggregation remains qualitative; the stated ratio and fiber length are unmeasured.
